title: Notice Required by 11 U.S.C. § 342(b) for Individuals Filing for Bankruptcy
notes: A Director's Form and a NOTICE, not a questionnaire: the 12/20 revision is a flat four-page PDF with no AcroForm and no caption, certification or signature block — the debtor's acknowledgement of having received it is B101 Part 7's own printed declaration, and the attorney's certification of having delivered it is B101 Part 7's attorney declaration. Nothing is filled; the packet carries the official notice verbatim, as the clerk's checklist (Director's Form 2000) expects it filed alongside the petition.
